mapper.select: select count(id) orderCount, date(order_time) date from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by date(order_time)
select count(id) validOrderCount, date(order_time) date from orders where status = 5 and order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by date(order_time)
select sum(amount) turnover, date(order_time) date from orders where status = 5 and order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by date(order_time)

select od.name name, sum(od.number) number from order_detail od, orders o where od.order_id = o.id and o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by od.name order by number desc limit 10
